agents.trigger: A stable stack validation receipt is present and a bounded local summary projection is requested.
agents.purpose: Summarize the current stack validation posture without mutating or reclassifying stack truth.
agents.expected_proof_artifact: A local shadow summary that cites the validation receipt path and counts without waiving findings or changing release posture.
agents.fallback_behavior: If the validation receipt is missing or contradictory, stop and route back to the operator with the raw receipt reference.
agents.owner_boundary: _stack validation and ATLAS docs remain the truth owners; this agent may summarize but may not waive findings or rewrite stack truth.
agents.non_claim_boundary: Not a deploy gate, not a release gate, and not a proof-admission authority surface.

agents.trigger: An operator requests a deterministic readback of current marker posture from ATLAS-owned state.
agents.purpose: Render the current marker posture from durable ATLAS state without inventing marker movement.
agents.expected_proof_artifact: A local checkpoint summary that repeats the current marker values and cites the durable ATLAS sources used.
agents.fallback_behavior: If marker and restart surfaces disagree, stop and route back to the operator with the conflicting refs instead of reconciling by inference.
agents.owner_boundary: ATLAS marker docs remain the truth owners; this agent may render checkpoint summaries but may not ratchet markers or rewrite the read model.
agents.non_claim_boundary: Not a ratchet authority and not a lane-selection authority surface.

agents.trigger: Explicit governed inputs are present for a bounded draft-only projection with no admission authority.
agents.purpose: Draft bounded receipt skeletons or doctrine-routing summaries from explicit governed inputs without claiming truth admission.
agents.expected_proof_artifact: A local shadow draft that names the governing receipt and doctrine refs and leaves final admission to human review.
agents.fallback_behavior: If source doctrine is ambiguous or under-specified, stop and return the unresolved references instead of drafting implied policy.
agents.owner_boundary: ATLAS and Playbook remain doctrine truth owners; this agent may draft but may not admit doctrine or finalize receipts.
agents.non_claim_boundary: Not a governance-admission surface and not a receipt-authority surface.

agents.family_name: fresh live proof capture through the frozen bridge path
agents.trigger: A request attempts fresh live proof capture before the frozen bridge blocker is cleared.
agents.trigger_family: fresh live proof capture through the frozen bridge path
agents.expected_proof_artifact: A fresh positive live proof bundle.
agents.fallback_behavior: Route back to the frozen bridge boundary and wait for one successful live Codex-to-Chrome runtime call.
agents.owner_boundary: Fitness proof capture and ATLAS restart truth remain the owners.
agents.non_claim_boundary: Not admissible for agent shadowing or authority while the external/session bridge defect remains active.
agents.blocked_reason: Blocked by the frozen Codex desktop <-> Chrome extension handshake/runtime defect and by the deterministic proof-loop threshold.

agents.trigger: A workflow asks Cortex to make a final deploy go or no-go decision.
agents.purpose: Make the final deploy go or no-go call.
agents.fallback_behavior: Defer to the human operator and `_stack` governed deploy authority.
agents.owner_boundary: _stack and the human operator remain the deployment authority surfaces.
agents.blocked_reason: Blocked because final deploy judgment remains permanently human-reviewed and approval-gated.

agents.trigger: A workflow asks Cortex to decide whether a public update should ship.
agents.purpose: Make the final public update or publication call.
agents.fallback_behavior: Defer to the human operator and the existing proof-gated publication boundary.
agents.owner_boundary: Discord publication truth remains operator- and proof-gated.
agents.blocked_reason: Blocked because final publication wording and timing remain human-reviewed.

agents.trigger: A workflow asks Cortex to ratify doctrine instead of returning a draft-only projection.
agents.fallback_behavior: Return a shadow draft and defer final admission to Playbook or operator review.
agents.owner_boundary: ATLAS and Playbook remain doctrine truth owners.
agents.blocked_reason: Blocked because doctrine admission remains a human-reviewed governance act.

agents.trigger: A workflow attempts destructive cleanup or secret-handling approval through Cortex.
agents.purpose: Approve destructive cleanup, secret handling, or other high-risk changes.
agents.expected_proof_artifact: An approval decision for high-risk mutation.
agents.fallback_behavior: Escalate back to the operator and the explicit approval gate.
agents.owner_boundary: The operator and the governing approval surface remain the authority.
agents.blocked_reason: Blocked because destructive cleanup and secret handling remain approval-gated.

agents.trigger: A workflow needs a judgment call on ambiguous visual or acceptance-quality evidence.
agents.purpose: Resolve ambiguous visual review or acceptance-criteria quality judgments.
agents.expected_proof_artifact: A judgment call about ambiguous visual or acceptance quality.
agents.fallback_behavior: Return the evidence refs and defer to human review.
agents.owner_boundary: Owner-repo truth and human review remain the authority surfaces.
agents.non_claim_boundary: Not admissible for shadow authority because the judgment class is intentionally human-owned.
agents.blocked_reason: Blocked because ambiguous visual and acceptance review still require human judgment.
